assets.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: finished transparent website logo wordmark for a Chinese programming learning park.
Primary request: Create a clean new logo using the supplied image as visual style reference. The EXACT main Chinese text is “蛋仔编程乐园” (six characters in this order: 蛋 仔 编 程 乐 园). Replace the reference wording entirely with these six characters. Do not include “派对”.
Style: playful chunky rounded Chinese lettering, sunny lemon-yellow face color, bold clean deep ocean-blue contour and a short solid blue extrusion/shadow offset down-right, closely inspired by the rounded energetic letter forms and yellow/blue contrast of the reference. Crisp polished 2D vector-like finish, very legible, restrained highlights, not 3D rendering. Avoid excessive angled skew or letter distortion.
Layout: a wide HORIZONTAL logo on a true transparent canvas, approximately 3:1 aspect ratio. All six characters in ONE continuous line, equal readable size, no line breaks. Fill the canvas efficiently with about 4% transparent margins. No large empty bands above or below. Wordmark rises very slightly toward right.
Mascot: one small cheerful golden egg character jumping at upper-right beside the final character, with a white face/belly patch, tiny eyes, simple mitten arms and feet, inspired by the bouncing egg in reference. Give its white belly a tiny simple blue pair of code angle brackets to suggest programming. Keep mascot compact so text remains the focus. Two tiny yellow four-point sparkle accents.
Background: actual alpha transparency.
Constraints: all text must accurately read 蛋仔编程乐园, no other Chinese or English text, no tagline, no website URL, no watermark, no checkerboard pattern, no white background, no enclosing plate, no mockup, no paper texture, no giant glows. Output only the finished logo.

Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: square brand mark / favicon companion to the attached “蛋仔编程乐园” wordmark.
Primary request: redraw ONLY the joyful small golden egg mascot at the upper-right of the attached logo as a standalone square icon. Preserve its identity and its bright yellow, white and deep ocean-blue palette.
Subject: one plump egg-shaped yellow character, white oval face/belly panel, two happy squeezed-shut eyes, a tiny cheerful orange open mouth, tiny rounded raised arms and little feet. A simple bold ocean-blue code symbol </> on its white belly. Confident deep blue smooth outline, slightly tilted as if jumping.
Style: clean playful 2D vector-like logo icon, very simple chunky readable shapes. Match attached logo design. Simplify small details so it works as a browser tab icon.
Composition: SQUARE, centered, complete character occupies about 88% of the square, balanced transparent margins; no clipping. No extra stars or sparkles or motion trails, just the mascot.
Background: actual alpha transparency.
Constraints: no wordmark, no Chinese or English text, no checkerboard, no white background rectangle, no mockup, no watermark, no paper texture, no shadow outside character.
